Set up your player

Enter the setup value from your SD card to pair this browser with your player.

The setup value is the contents of /boot/evo/pair-preseed.txt on the SD card. You wrote it there before first boot. If you didn't, hold the reset button while powering the player back on and try again with a fresh SD card.

Set a player password

You'll type this password to allow important changes (like removing shares or resetting the player).

Choose something you'll remember. If you forget it, hold the reset button while powering the player back on to start over.

Player is ready

Your browser is paired. Sending you to the player home page now.
